races.paceDynamic: Donna Rumma will dictate terms from the front with her proven pace-setting ability, likely getting an uncontested lead given the lack of other confirmed front-runners. The prominent runners Lake Muritz, Silesia, and potentially Persian Sunset will track her through reasonable fractions on this soft ground. With Love A Giggle and Showmethebubbles held up at the back, this sets up as a straightforward pace scenario where the leader gets first run but may be vulnerable to strong closers if the pace is honest. This race shape favors prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, as they get the best of both worlds - avoiding traffic while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Donna Rumma Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Donna Rumma gets soft fractions uncontested on the lead.
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable splits and prove too tough to catch in the final furlong, especially with her solid recent form on similar ground. Her pace-setting style gives her first run on rivals who must come from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Muritz or Silesia can sit perfectly behind Donna Rumma and unleash late.
scenarios.body: The Allan/Easterby combination with Lake Muritz looks particularly dangerous from this tactical position, able to save ground and pounce when the leader tires. Their prominent style avoids the traffic that hold-up horses may encounter.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If Love A Giggle can reproduce her winning form from a similar position.
scenarios.body: Burke's filly won last time from off the pace and could benefit if the early pace is strong enough to set up her closing kick. The 7lb penalty makes it tougher but her style could exploit tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Persian Sunset Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Persian Sunset shows significant improvement from her debut.
scenarios.body: Being relatively unexposed, she could have more to offer than her rating suggests, and Hart/De Foy may have found the right spot for improvement. Her unknown style could catch rivals off guard.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Donna Rumma gets too easy a lead - she could steal this if fractions are too comfortable early.
Monitor the pace through the first two furlongs - if it's genuinely strong, Love A Giggle becomes much more dangerous.
Keep an eye on Persian Sunset's market moves as any support would suggest stable confidence in this lightly-raced type.
Watch for traffic problems affecting the hold-up horses Love A Giggle and Showmethebubbles in this small but potentially bunched field.
Observe how Lake Muritz settles behind Donna Rumma - if he tracks her smoothly, the Allan/Easterby combination looks well-placed to strike.

races.paceDynamic: Hvar looks the only confirmed front runner in this field of 16, likely to lead from the off without serious early pressure. The prominent runners like Showtown, Yellow Diamonds, and Star Noir will track close behind but none are natural pace-pressers. With soft ground and a single leader setting sustainable fractions, this sets up perfectly for horses that can travel strongly in behind and produce a finishing kick. The pace scenario heavily favours hold-up horses and those with tactical speed who can position off the pace and strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Hvar gets an easy lead and the pace is too slow for closers to reel him in
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear when it matters. Prominent runners who can quicken from good positions also benefit from the honest but sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finishing Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to set up the hold-up horses perfectly
scenarios.body: The soft ground and honest pace creates ideal conditions for the patient brigade to unleash late runs. Horses with proven finishing kicks can sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy horses can get first run on the leaders and sustain their effort
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get ideal position tracking the lone leader and can strike before the hold-up horses get organized. Experience at the trip and tactical positioning proves crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and it becomes a messy sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace turns it into a lottery where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize. Track position and jockey timing become more important than running style.

watchPoints.text: Hvar must be watched for market confidence as the likely lone leader could prove hard to peg back if getting soft fractions
Yellow Diamonds has the class edge but stepping up significantly in grade after comfortable soft ground win
Artista's hold-up style needs genuine pace but trainer's 2/13 recent record raises concerns about current stable form
O Fortuna carries just 119lbs and could be overpriced given the weight advantage in a competitive handicap
Showtown has been consistent in similar company and Jason Hart's partnership with Hvar creates interesting tactical angle

races.paceDynamic: Hedge Fund is the sole confirmed front runner and will take them along at a comfortable gallop without pressure early. The prominent racers Copper Knight, Master Of My Fate, Canon's House, Emerald Harmony and Hundred Caps will track closely behind, creating a bunched field through the early stages. With only Trilby and Ventura Express held up, the pace will be genuine but not destructive over this sharp 5f at Beverley. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position handy and quicken, as there's insufficient pace pressure to set it up for the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get first run on Hedge Fund turning for home
scenarios.body: Copper Knight, Master Of My Fate, Canon's House, Emerald Harmony or Hundred Caps will have ideal positioning to strike. The lack of pace pressure means they'll have plenty left in the tank to quicken decisively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Hedge Fund gets an uncontested lead and finds extra under pressure
scenarios.body: The 198-day break is a concern but Michael Appleby's charge has the tactical advantage and TS rating of 91 suggests genuine ability. Without sustained pressure, he could pinch it.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Trilby and Ventura Express would benefit from a slow-run race that becomes a sprint. However, with several prominent runners likely to quicken, this scenario requires multiple pace failures.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Hedge Fund stops quickly and the prominent pack comes back to the field
scenarios.body: This would create a messy finish where any horse with a turn of foot could prevail. The most unlikely scenario given the probable pace dynamic.

watchPoints.text: Hedge Fund's fitness after 198 days off - if he shows any signs of blowing up early, the race dynamic changes completely
Copper Knight's jumping from the stalls at 12 years old - any sluggish start would compromise his prominent tactics
Master Of My Fate and the 5lb claimer Rhys Elliott - inexperienced jockey could get caught out of position in a tactical finish
Trilby and Ventura Express need to see how quickly the pace develops - if it's genuinely strong they become live chances
Canon's House returning from 30-day break - watch for any signs of ring rustiness or lack of fitness early doors

races.paceDynamic: Sea Master will take the field along at a steady gallop, but faces immediate pressure from four prominent racers: Freddy Robinson, Assured, El Ghaawy, The Pug, and Daring Leader all wanting to track the leader closely. This congestion will create tactical complications turning for home when multiple horses try to improve position simultaneously. The relatively sustainable early pace on soft ground over 1m4f will preserve stamina for a strong finish. This race shape favors hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and deliver late challenges when the prominent pack gets shuffled.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates a wall of horses 3f out blocking each other's runs
scenarios.body: The early pace stays manageable allowing Sea Master to string them out, but the five prominent runners get in each other's way when the race develops. Clean hold-up horses like Kameel and Cloudy Rose sweep past the stalled leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Master gets an uncontested lead and the prominent horses settle too far back
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Sea Master to dictate terms completely, building an unassailable advantage before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. His recent Soft going win and headgear change suggest he's primed for another front-running success.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners engage in a speed duel trying to track Sea Master
scenarios.body: The sustained early pace becomes unsustainable on the testing ground, setting up the race perfectly for the three hold-up horses. Muhib's 7lb weight advantage and Warren Fentiman's claim become decisive factors in the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Masterclass
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner (Freddy Robinson or Daring Leader) gets the perfect stalking position while others get trapped
scenarios.body: The race unfolds as a chess match where positioning trumps pure ability, with the best-placed prominent runner having enough left to hold off the late challengers. Freddy Robinson's local jockey knowledge could prove crucial in navigating the traffic.

Watch for traffic problems affecting Cloudy Rose who needs room to mount her customary late challenge

races.paceDynamic: Mandarin Spirit will dictate terms from the front as the sole confirmed leader, creating a measured gallop that won't be unsustainable early. The real battle develops behind with Jungle Ruler, North Force, Suddenly I See, The Resdev Scholar, Lyrical Song, Dunkeld Dreamer, Cool Molly and Night Patrol all wanting prominent positions - this creates significant traffic issues turning for home. Only Gorey Gold sits off the pace as a genuine hold-up horse. This pace setup strongly favours the lone front-runner Mandarin Spirit and any prominent racers who can secure clean racing room, while the hold-up runner Gorey Gold faces a difficult task against what will likely be a steady tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mandarin Spirit gets an uncontested lead and quickens turning for home
scenarios.body: The lone leader exploits the prominent congestion behind and proves hard to peg back up the straight. The sustained gallop plays to his front-running style while the chasing pack gets tangled up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royale
scenarios.trigger: If the eight prominent runners engage in early scrimmaging for position behind Mandarin Spirit
scenarios.body: The pace quickens as multiple horses jostle for the ideal stalking spot, setting up a cavalry charge finish. Those with the best racing room and strongest finishing kicks prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mandarin Spirit sets pedestrian fractions and the prominent pack goes to sleep
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows Gorey Gold to close strongly from the rear as the leaders tire. His fresh finishing kick proves decisive against horses who've been racing keenly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If heavy traffic problems cause multiple prominent runners to be shuffled back
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish with several runners making late progress from compromised positions. Those finding clear runs late capitalize on others' misfortune.

Observe Cool Molly's action on turf debut as her all-weather form may not translate to grass surface

Watch Gorey Gold's early positioning as the hold-up horse needs to drop out completely to be effective from the rear

races.paceDynamic: Evelyn's Phoenix is the sole confirmed front runner and will set his own tempo from flag to finish without early pressure. The prominent runners Copper And Five, Law Degree, Penny Ghent, and Nakatomi will track behind but lack the natural pace to challenge the leader early. This creates a tactical race where the front runner controls proceedings through moderate fractions, while the large contingent of hold-up horses (Hostelry, Pisanello, Coolree, Cloch Nua, Woodleigh, Dandy's Angel, Bantz, Far Ahead, Wath Court, Rajawail) must rely on the pace quickening late. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, as the controlled early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Win
scenarios.trigger: If Evelyn's Phoenix maintains his lead through steady fractions and kicks clear in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to dictate terms and prove too strong when the field challenges. His recent course and distance win confirms his effectiveness when allowed to control the tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the steady early pace sets up a sprint finish where class and finishing speed decide the outcome.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their kicks, with Pisanello and Hostelry having the highest ratings to capitalise. The soft ground favours strong finishers over pure speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Copper And Five or Law Degree track the leader perfectly and time their challenge to perfection.
scenarios.body: These horses avoid the kickback from behind while staying close enough to strike when Evelyn's Phoenix weakens. Their prominent style gets the best of both worlds in this tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If an unfancied hold-up horse produces a career-best performance to shock the field.
scenarios.body: The controlled pace and large field creates opportunities for horses like Cloch Nua or Dandy's Angel to find gaps and outrun their odds. Sometimes these handicaps produce surprise winners from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Evelyn's Phoenix could steal this if allowed uncontested lead through slow early fractions then quickens clear
Pisanello has the class edge over most of these and gets ideal setup for his hold-up style
Copper And Five is perfectly positioned to track the leader and could time challenge perfectly
Law Degree represents in-form Tim Easterby yard and his prominent style suits this tactical affair
Weather conditions could deteriorate further making it even more stamina-sapping for the finishers
